scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @pg-planner/api" "npm run dev -w @pg-planner/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pg-planner/api && npm run build -w @pg-planner/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pg-planner/api && npm run typecheck -w @pg-planner/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @pg-planner/api && npm run lint -w @pg-planner/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pg-planner/api && npm run test -w @pg-planner/web
